Account Access.description: Issues related to logging in, passwords, authentication, permissions, or access to company accounts and services.

Hardware.description: Issues involving physical computer equipment or peripherals.

Network.description: Issues related to internet connectivity, VPN, Wi-Fi, or access to network resources.

Software.description: Issues involving installed applications, software crashes, errors, updates, or application functionality.

Low.description: The issue has limited impact and the user can continue most of their work.

Medium.description: The issue affects normal work but does not completely block critical activity.

High.description: The issue significantly blocks the user's work or affects an important business function.
